chapter: Family background and the Tulsa music scene
title: Running errands for the bands
summary: As a boy he fetched sandwiches and cigarettes for musicians.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Was this -- the section rehearsals in the separate rooms, was this something you remember about a specific band, or all the bands?
All the bands did that. You know?
What kind of messages did you carry for them? Musical messages, or --

No, I'd go to get sandwiches and things, you know, and go ahead and get cigarettes for them. 'Course at that time there was no such thing you couldn't sell cigarettes to kids, you know, because they just knew that you were going to get them for your parents or a grownup, you know. And that's how I started smoking. (laughs)
